summary: A port of the MonkSynth formant vocal synthesizer: a single sung voice with twelve animated characters, each with its own voice and stage, whose mouths follow the vowel.
features: FOF formant synthesis with five interpolated vowels, breath and head size
Monophonic with glide; choir unison of up to 10 voices
Velocity and aftertouch from the stock keys, no hardware changes
Aftertouch moves the vowel, bends pitch, or both
USB MIDI in and out, including polyphonic aftertouch and CCs
Talks to the FM-1 Screen Reader over USB; no sequencer

headings: monk-1: twelve singers for the fm-1
how the keys sense velocity and aftertouch
